data.name: Kalima
data.gender_notes: Kalima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kalima is a term used in Islamic tradition to refer to the declaration of faith, 'La ilaha illallah Muhammadun Rasulullah', meaning 'There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah'. The name Kalima carries the meaning “Statement of faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kalima usually hope their child will grow to embody statement of faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and commitment to the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Kalima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Statement of faith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalima total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: كلمة
in_arabic.meaning: كلمة تعني كلام أو قول أو كلمة الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: كلمة هي اسم مؤنث في اللغة العربية، مشتق من الفعل 'كلم' الذي يعني التحدث أو قول شيء. في القرآن الكريم، كلمة الله تعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى، وتشير إلى كلام الله أو رسالته للناس. اسم كلمة يحمل معاني عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالتواصل مع الله من خلال كلامه المقدس.

in_urdu.name: کلیما
in_urdu.meaning: کلیما کا مطلب ہے کلام یا قول یا اللہ کی بات
in_urdu.long_meaning: کلیما عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ایک نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کلام، قول یا بات۔ یہ نام اللہ کی کلام اور وحی کے تصور سے جڑا ہوا ہے، جو اسلامی ثقافت اور عقیدت میں اہم کردار ادا کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، کلیما نام روحانی اہمیت اور ان کی اسلامی شناخت سے منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कलीमा
in_hindi.meaning: कलीमा का अर्थ है बात या वाणी या ईश्वर की बात
in_hindi.long_meaning: कलीमा एक ऐसा नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बात, वाणी या ईश्वर की बात। यह नाम ईश्वर के वचन और उसके पवित्र संदेश के विचार से जुड़ा हुआ है, जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में आध्यात्मिक महत्व और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: کالیما
in_pashto.meaning: کالیما د معنی دی کلام یا خبر یا د الله خبر
in_pashto.long_meaning: کالیما د یوې نجلۍ نوم دی چې په پښتو کې د کلام یا خبرو معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمو کې د دیني او کلتوري ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري، او د الله د پیغام یا وحی مفهوم پورې اړه لري.

Historically, the name Kalima holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the sacred dialogue between God and humanity. Across Muslim cultures, Kalima embodies the essence of divine revelation and prophetic messages.

data.cultural_impact: The declaration of faith, known as Kalima Sharaif, forms the foundation of an individual's identity as a Muslim. It is a crucial component of Islamic culture, emphasizing the unity of God and the belief in Muhammad as His messenger. The recital of the Kalima is often the first lesson a newly-born child receives and marks the beginning of their religious education and upbringing. Moreover, the Kalima is not just a personal endeavor but also a bond that unites the entire Muslim community, transcending national, cultural, and linguistic boundaries.
data.spiritual_significance: The Kalima holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims as it represents their devotion and submission to Allah and recognizes Prophet Muhammad as His chosen messenger. It symbolizes the seeking of guidance from Allah, entrusting one's life and fate in His hands, and striving to live a life in accordance with His divine will. Through sincere recitation and practice of the Kalima, a Muslim seeks nearness to Allah, obtains inner peace, and strengthens their bond with their Creator. It is an essential part of daily prayers, and its importance is emphasized throughout the Holy Quran.
